name: Georgia
famous_for: Birthplace of wine (8,000-year Qvevri method), Caucasus mountain towers of Svaneti, and Khachapuri cheese bread.
tourists: Over 7.1M visitors; highlights include Gergeti Trinity Church below Mount Kazbek, Vardzia cave city, and Old Tbilisi sulfur baths.
must_know: The 'Supra' is a traditional feast led by a toastmaster (Tamada) celebrating life with elaborate philosophical toasts.
fun_fact: Archaeologists in Georgia discovered ceramic jars with wine residue dating back 8,000 years (6,000 BC).
